name: Squish Switch
description: A switch whose handle stretches as you drag it and, when you let go, a spring throws it to one end.
interactionNotes: You can click it like any switch, or grab the handle and drag it. As you drag, the handle stretches in proportion to your movement speed but doesn't get wider, and the state changes the moment it crosses the middle. On release, the spring throws it to the nearest end. When the cursor arrives it grows slightly, and Escape mid-drag returns everything to the previous state.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled value. If you want it uncontrolled, don't pass this.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Returns the new state on every change.

props.name: label
props.description: The text next to the switch. If given, clicking it also toggles the switch (via `htmlFor`).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims it and makes it non-interactive.

props.name: trackColor
props.description: Track color in the off state.

props.name: trackOnColor
props.description: Track color in the on state.

props.name: thumbColor
props.description: Handle color in the off state. Leave it empty to build it from a mix of `trackOnColor` and `trackColor`.

props.name: thumbOnColor
props.description: Handle color in the on state. Leave it empty to use `trackColor` itself.

props.name: height
props.description: Track height; the handle's inset from the edge and the handle's own size are calculated from it.

props.name: radius
props.description: Track corner radius. Above half the height it is clipped to half (a pill switch).

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed at which the handle reaches the other end, between 0 and 100. A higher number means softer and more stretched out.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How strongly the handle stretches, between 0 and 100. Zero means the handle doesn't deform at all.

props.name: hoverScale
props.description: How much the handle grows when the cursor is over it. 1 means no reaction (mouse only).

props.name: colorDuration
props.description: Duration of the track and handle color transition, milliseconds.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Screen reader label. It isn't needed if `label` has text.

props.name: id
props.description: The switch id; if you don't give one, a unique id is generated.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the component root.

tips: For frequently used switches, set `speed` around 70 so the motion is calmer; high speed is for switches the user "plays" with.
If you set `stretch` to zero and `hoverScale` to 1, what's left is a clean ordinary switch — no stretching and no cursor reaction.
You can also pass colors with a CSS variable: `trackOnColor="var(--color-brand)"`.
